_pendingDisallowanceSets: DIS-S202-2A (basis REG-NEW-DISALLOW-001, s.202(2)(a)) is NOT declared yet, and NEW_TAX_REGIME does not reference it. A DisallowanceSet that forbids nothing is refused, because in a finished pack a regime referencing one would be unaffected. The first rule it forbids exists — SAL-TAX-ON-EMPLOYMENT (s.19(1) Table Sl. 1), excluded from this regime by its own ExceptIn until the set is built with run-time application (D-093, Appendix F). It becomes real when that lands; the rules it forbids are: Schedule III Sl. Nos. 5, 6, 7, 8, 11, 17; Sl. 12, 13 other than as prescribed; s.19(1) Table Sl. 1; s.22(1)(b) for s.21(6); ss.33(8), 48, 49, 45(3)(a)/(b)/(c), 46, 47(1)(a); and the whole of Chapter VIII except ss.124(1), 124(2), 125(2) and 146.
displayName: New tax regime for individuals, Hindu undivided family and others (s.202(1))

provenance.sourceDescription: Gazette CG-DL-E-16082024-256436, Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 s.37, p.29 — Income-tax Act, 1961 s.115BAC(1A) as substituted: the new regime's rates apply to a person "other than a person who has exercised an option under sub-section (6)" — the default unless the option is exercised (D-133)
provenance.whatToCheck: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.21AGA and Form 10-IEA — the "manner as may be prescribed" for the option under Income-tax Act, 1961 s.115BAC(6), which may make the vehicle a prescribed form for a person with business income — and the interim Finance Act, 2024 (8 of 2024); the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024 s.37 and the Finance Act, 2025 s.25 were read and amend s.115BAC(1A) only.
